title: AG-UI Agent Specification
description: Schema for AG-UI agent-side specifications. Codifies the structural rules described in references/domain/ag-ui.md so that constraint validation has a deterministic source of truth. Cross-reference integrity (tool names in event_emission must reference declared tools; on_event values must be valid AG-UI event kinds) is enforced by the normalization adapter, not by this schema.

version.description: Spec version marker, e.g. 'ag-ui/v1'. Required at the top of every AG-UI spec.

agent.description: Agent identity block — name and optional description.

tools.description: List of tools the agent exposes. Each name must be unique within this spec.

event_emission.description: Rules declaring which tools emit which AG-UI events and which UI fragment they bind to. The normalizer validates that every tool reference resolves to a declared tool and every on_event is a valid AG-UI event kind.

custom_events.description: Application-defined AG-UI CUSTOM event kinds with their payload schemas. Required whenever event_emission references on_event='CUSTOM'.

metadata.description: Optional spec-level metadata. Free-form; kept opaque to validators.

toolName.description: snake_case tool name, locally unique within the agent's tool list.

agEventKind.description: Valid AG-UI protocol event kinds per the CopilotKit AG-UI specification.

customEventKind.description: Application-defined custom event kind. Must start with 'CUSTOM_' followed by uppercase letters and underscores.

description.description: Short description of the agent's purpose.
Human-readable description of what the tool does. Included in the model's tool list.

parameters.description: JSON Schema object describing the tool's parameter envelope. Omit for tools with no parameters.

returns.description: Optional JSON Schema describing the tool's return value shape.

tool.description: The tool name that triggers this emission. Must reference a name in spec.tools.

on_event.description: The AG-UI event kind emitted when this tool is invoked. The normalizer validates this against the canonical event kind registry.

fragment.description: Optional UI component slot or CopilotKit component identifier bound to this event emission.

condition.description: Optional human-readable description of the condition under which this rule fires. Informational only — not machine-evaluated.

kind.description: Unique application-defined event kind. Must start with 'CUSTOM_'.

description.description: Human-readable description of when this custom event is emitted and what its payload represents.

schema.description: Optional JSON Schema object for the custom event payload.
